title: News & events
intro: Stay up to date with our latest news, announcements and upcoming events.

items.title: New research grant awarded for sustainable urban mobility
items.summary: Our department has secured funding to develop next-generation public transport analysis models. The project will run for three years with international academic partners.

items.title: Annual conference on digital innovation and artificial intelligence
items.summary: Join researchers and industry experts to explore recent developments in applied machine learning. Registration is open to students and faculty members.

items.title: Publication of the environmental impact report
items.summary: The research team released its latest findings on local air quality trends and mitigation strategies. The full report is now available online for public download.

items.title: International workshop on renewable energy integration
items.summary: A two-day interactive workshop focused on smart grid optimisation and clean energy storage solutions. Keynote speakers include leading scholars in the field.

items.title: Seminar series: Modern approaches to public health data
items.location: Faculty of Medicine – Lecture Theatre A
items.summary: Guest lectures examining statistical modelling techniques for monitoring community health outcomes. Open to all students, researchers and healthcare practitioners.

items.title: Student innovation showcase and networking reception
items.summary: Graduate students will present their interdisciplinary prototypes to academic and industrial mentors. Attendees can discuss potential research collaborations during the session.
